source: blueprint-2026-06-02.md (June 2 Blueprint; claims quoted verbatim with line numbers)

claims.title: Goal (global NS regularity)
claims.statement: (L5) Goal**: Every smooth, divergence-free initial velocity field on T³ generates a unique globally smooth solution to the 3D incompressible Navier–Stokes equations.

claims.title: Tether as minimal bilinear symmetric correction (corrected)
claims.statement: (L411) Geometric theorem first (§2): The Frohmanian Symplectic Tether 𝔗_F is constructed as the unique (up to gauge) minimal bilinear symmetric correction to Arnold’s Lie–Poisson bracket that satisfies axioms (A1)–(A5) or conditions (C1)–(C3). [author correction 2026-11-03: the source Blueprint (L411) says “antisymmetric”; the author states this was a slip and the tether term is symmetric. The source file blueprint-2026-06-02.md is unchanged.]

claims.title: Quadratic metric correction with pointwise weight
claims.statement: (L412) Uniqueness forces the analytic object (§2.7–2.8): The quadratic metric correction B(F,G) ∝ −κ |ω|² (δF/δω · δG/δω) (with Π_u) is proven to be the only lowest-order term compatible with degeneracy on H, coadjoint invariance, and negative quadratic feedback on stretching.

claims.title: Step 1 locality from coadjoint invariance
claims.statement: (L581) `step1_locality` (depends only on invariance under coadjoint action)

claims.title: Comparison majorant ODE
claims.statement: (L594) Independent comparison majorant ODE y' = C y² − κ'' y³ (completely decoupled from NS).

claims.title: kappa forced to C_CZ(3)
claims.statement: (L716) Is the coefficient κ forced to be exactly C_CZ(3), with a clear demonstration that any smaller value would violate (C3)?

claims.title: Tether term and tethered bracket (author description, 2026-11-03)
claims.statement: T(ω)(F,G)=−κ∫|ω(x)|²⟨Π_uδF,Π_uδG⟩dx (pointwise weight; sign −κ per author correction 2026-11-03, the earlier +κ was a slip), and {F,G}_T = {F,G}_cl + T.

ac1c56b744f6.question: What does transitivity mean? (recorded by hand via mismatchId key q6-transitivity)
ac1c56b744f6.answer: transitivity = transitive_on_casimir_levels: ∀ ω₁ ω₂, (∀ f, ∫ f‖ω₁‖ = ∫ f‖ω₂‖) → ∃ g, g•ω₁=ω₂; stays an open named assumption.

d7406df19c88.question: Is δH = BS*BS ω or u? (recorded by hand via mismatchId key q7-deltaH)
d7406df19c88.answer: δH = u = velocity_from_vorticity ω, not BS*BS. Make FunctionalDerivative KineticEnergyHamiltonian ω = velocity_from_vorticity ω a named hypothesis or a proof.

aa4c9d021f78.answer: Blueprint 'antisymmetric' for the tether term was a slip; correct it to symmetric in the excerpts.

baa3e5e01284.question: Sign of the tether: +κ (prose) or −κ (Lean TetherKernel)? (recorded by hand via mismatchId key qa-sign)
baa3e5e01284.answer: A: −κ (damping, matches the Lean). That is the intended canonical version. The tether exists to supply negative feedback that can absorb the vortex-stretching term; only the minus sign produces the cubic damping. The +κ that appeared in the earlier prose description was the slip.

4b8c6e44d1ee.question: Does the full tethered bracket {F,G}_cl + T stay antisymmetric? (recorded by hand via mismatchId key qc-bracket-antisym)
4b8c6e44d1ee.answer: UNRESOLVED FACTUAL CONFLICT (not adopted). Author's claim, verbatim: "the full tethered bracket remains antisymmetric because it is the sum of the antisymmetric classical bracket and a symmetric correction that is placed in the appropriate slot." This is false in general: {F,F}_T = {F,F}_cl + T(F,F) = T(F,F) ≠ 0. Antisymmetric + nonzero symmetric is not antisymmetric (metriplectic/Leibniz-type, not Lie–Poisson). Not written into any paper or extract.
